tools.name: risetive_search_jev
tools.description: Match one concise need to up to five current Jev projects and return their public details.

tools.name: risetive_jev_whats_new
tools.description: Return up to ten Jev projects with a confirmed first catalog-admission record, newest first.

tools.name: risetive_find_market
tools.description: Find up to five current public markets matching a product description or idea, with bounded market evidence.

tools.name: risetive_market_players
tools.description: Return up to eight representative public products for one market; no pagination or full-corpus export.

tools.name: risetive_product_profile
tools.description: Read one public product identity, primary market, Standard Data metrics, pricing evidence and market position by domain.

tools.name: risetive_new_entrants
tools.description: Return up to ten public products most recently admitted to Risetive in one market; admission is not a launch date.

tools.name: risetive_keyword_research
tools.description: Search the public keyword ranking, inspect one keyword, or read saved keyword evidence for one public product. Search page 1 is anonymous; later search pages require Clerk OAuth.

tools.name: risetive_backlink_research
tools.description: Search public backlink channels, inspect one channel, or read saved backlink evidence for one public product. Search page 1 is anonymous; later search pages require Clerk OAuth.

tools.name: risetive_published_insights
tools.description: Return up to twelve latest published product and market insight cards with their full public content. Drafts and review previews are excluded.

tools.name: risetive_home_rankings
tools.description: Return the current homepage product-growth and market-opportunity rankings with their actual comparison window and public detail links.

tools.name: risetive_growth_tools
tools.description: List current growth-task categories and return a bounded page of matching public tools, with optional category, text, and exact-tool selection.

tools.name: risetive_save_item
tools.description: Save one current public item for the authenticated Clerk user. Use a market slug, a product id from a Risetive product tool, or a Jev resourceId as key.

tools.name: risetive_list_saved_items
tools.description: List the authenticated Clerk user's saved markets, products, and Jev projects.

tools.name: risetive_remove_saved_item
tools.description: Remove one saved-item relation owned by the authenticated Clerk user.
